I replied to Tobias in your DM: from now on, his standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team for the Elmstead rollout is Mondays at 8:45. I didn't do anything else, because he said no action was needed. That means no calendar event and nothing posted anywhere.

I didn't save it to memory separately. The workspace brain stores every direct message as a fact that only Tobias can see, so the note is there for him.
